name: separator
title: Separator
description: A one-pixel horizontal or vertical rule that separates content, decorative by default and semantic on request.
author: Design From <https://labs.designfrom.com>

props.name: decorative
props.description: When true the separator is presentational and hidden from assistive technology.

a11y: Decorative by default, so assistive technology skips it.
Set decorative={false} when the rule separates content semantically; it then exposes role="separator" with aria-orientation.
